newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 22.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- President Jiang Zemin meets Uruguayan president Julio Maria Sanguinetti
- First People's Liberation Army troops arrive in Hong Kong
- China launches nationwide campaign to crack down on drugs
FINANCIAL NEWS
- Central bank refoems its personnel system promotes young officials and boosts exchange of officials among departments
- State Agricultural Development Bank makes 7.461 billion yuan loans for poverty relief by end-march
- Central bank renews busines licence of Shenzhen Development Bank
- China plans to boost annual crude processing capacity to 220 million tonnes by 2000, to boost annual ethylene output capacity to 5.0 billion tonnes
INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS DAILY
- Bank settlement, arbitration system and insurance on letters of credit are three main obstacles in Sino-Russia trade
- Editorial examines impact of unified European currency on China's foreign exchange reserves
ECONOMIC DAILY
- Ministry of Internal Trade issues urgent notice ordering local governments to prevent further falls in egg prices
- Sino-Russia trade hit $6.85 billion in 1996, expected to reach $8.0-10 billion in 1997 and $20 billion by 2000
MARKET DAILY
- State Planning Commission issues rules to regulate prices of imported medicine
ECONOMIC INFORMATION DAILY
- China power sector sales hit 53.059 billion yuan in first quarter
- Non-state firms in 250 million yuan road project in Quanzhou in eastern Fujian province
- China edible oil processing capacity exceeds demand
CHINA DAILY
- Premier Li Peng stresses closer ties with Africa
- Minister of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation Wu Yi says China's position on World Trade Organisation entry is clear-cut
